items.text: First meeting with project manager Sarah to introduce team and agenda for remote control development.
Team has 25 minutes to cover introductions, tool training, project plan, and idea discussion.
Project involves developing a remote control that is original, trendy, market-appropriate, and user-friendly for all ages.
Meeting structure includes functional design, conceptual design, and detailed design phases.
Team will practice drawing favorite animals on the whiteboard using pens, with Sarah going first.
